results.statement: For two disjoint physical coordinate pairs and a physical pivot with d!=0, if the 2x2 Schur cross C=B-ab^T/d has Delta=|det C|>0, then ||p_Q||_infinity <= 4^(7/4)3^(-1/4)|d|^(-1/2)Delta^(-1/4), uniformly over all outside conditioning and arbitrary within-pair quadratic-affine terms.

For T=2aX(alpha.Y)+H(alpha.Y)+b[(beta.Z)+theta(alpha.Y)]^2 on disjoint independent product-coordinate groups, ||p_T||_infinity <=2^(11/4)/(sqrt(|ab|)||alpha||_2^(1/2)||beta||_2). The rank-three star-plus-square target branch is therefore <=2^(11/4)<6.728.
